prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic fashion campaign poster featuring an adult male model with curly hair, light stubble and tinted rectangular sunglasses, posing in a confident relaxed stance. He wears an oversized glossy purple puffer jacket with a large hood, styled in a high-fashion streetwear aesthetic. Branding elements: use only approved The North Face and Nike co-branded logos, subtle graphic patches such as a smiley icon and abstract symbols, and no invented marks. Composition is a medium close-up with a slightly angled pose, direct calm expression, jacket filling most of the frame with exaggerated volume and texture. Background is a deep purple gradient wall with large graffiti-style white brushstroke typography slightly blurred for depth. Use cinematic high-contrast lighting with cool purple tones and warm orange rim light on one side of the jacket. Typography layout: approved collaboration logos top left, product description block left, approved tagline I have to wear it to bear it on the right, and Winter Collection at bottom. Style: luxury streetwear campaign, editorial photography, ultra-detailed, 8K, shallow depth of field, soft grain, modern graphic overlays, clean but bold layout. Aspect ratio 3:4.
